title: netsend
description: send Pd messages over a network

messages.description: nonzero if connection is open, zero otherwise
messages sent back from netreceive objects

methods.description: sets host and port number, an additional port argument can be set for messages sent back from the receiver

body: [netsend] sends messages over the network to a [netreceive] object or other software, over TCP by default or UDP with -u. 'connect' takes a host name or address and a port, 'send' sends a message, and the left outlet is 1 while connected. With -b, messages are sent as lists of bytes.
